action_input.code:
import pandas as pd
import sqlite3

# Load superhero data from CSV
superheroes = pd.read_csv('csv/superhero.csv')

# Connect to the database and get heroes with Super Strength (power_id=18)
conn = sqlite3.connect('db/hero_power.db')
heroes_with_super_strength = pd.read_sql_query(
    "SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id = 18",
    conn
)
conn.close()

# Filter superheroes with height > 200
superheroes_filtered = superheroes[superheroes['height_cm'] > 200]

# Find intersection between heroes with Super Strength and those with height > 200
result = heroes_with_super_strength.merge(
    superheroes_filtered[['id']], 
    left_on='hero_id', 
    right_on='id'
)

count = len(result)
print(count)
